text:
Jonah: Quick heads-up — Legal flagged potential redistribution restriction on Eos-7B-lite we're planning to quantize and onboard. License here: https://vendor.example/models/eos-7b-lite/LICENSE. Does distributing quantized weights count as redistribution?
Priya: @Jonah linking. I skimmed the license; it's a CC-like header + "non-commercial" clause and an extra "no rehosting" paragraph. Need to confirm exact SPDX; can you paste the license header?
Sam: Pasting top section:
```
Copyright 2025 ModelVendor Inc.
Licensed under CC-BY-NC-SA 4.0 with additional clause: "No public redistribution of model weights or converted weights without express written permission."
```
Sam: Our plan was to ship quantized weights to Dedicated customers and provide hosted API for others. That may violate the "no public redistribution" if we include weights in downloads.
Marta: For Private installs we need to allow customers to run on-prem; we typically provide weights in a tarball. If license forbids redistribution, that's a legal problem for Private package.
Priya: Agree. Two legal questions: (1) Does a quantized file count as "derived"/"redistribution" (likely yes). (2) Is providing weights to a contracted Dedicated/Private customer allowed under "written permission" or covered by a commercial license? We need vendor contact.
Jonah: @Priya can you check whether commercial licensing is an option? I'll pause the model-onboard PR for now. :pause_button:
LegalBot: Action item created: COMPLIANCE-312 — Reach out to ModelVendor for redistribution permission and commercial license terms. Assigned to Priya. Due: 2026-03-27.
Sam: Another thought — could we avoid shipping weights by using remote-pull for Private installs (customer pulls from vendor) or by offering only API/Dedicated? That reduces surface.
Marta: Remote-pull still implies the customer gets weights; contractually the vendor might still consider that redistribution unless they control the transfer.
Priya: For the onboarding doc, if vendor denies redistribution we should: (a) mark model as "no-redistribute" in catalog metadata, (b) disable weight-export in private installers, (c) add attribution text in UI and attribution field in API responses as required by CC-BY style clauses.
Jonah: Noted. Also check whether attribution must be on every inference response (unlikely) or just in UI/legal docs.
Sam: Small QA note: quantization modifies weights; some licenses treat modifications differently — e.g., "no derivatives" vs "no redistribution". We need exact wording.
Priya: I'll push a short checklist to the compliance ticket: license excerpt, vendor contact, recommended catalog flags (redistribute: no/yes with permission), required attribution text.
Jonah: OK thanks. Pausing onboarding until COMPLIANCE-312 updates. :eyes:
Marta: :thumbsup:
Priya: Will update by EOD tomorrow.
